evidence.why: Fighter extraction, motion change and callback installation.
Article guard, current-motion dispatch, lifecycle writes and conditional self-clear.

facts.rationale: Preserves the entry's direct flow while correcting the omitted article-existence guard and dispatch-time state dependency.
facts.value: Derives Fighter from gobj, passes gobj and ftGw_MS_Attack100End to Fighter_ChangeMotionState, and installs ftGw_Attack11_DecideAction in accessory4_cb. At deferred dispatch, DecideAction first requires a non-null Greenhouse pointer, then reads the current motion_id; Attack100End selects itGamewatchGreenhouse_802C64A8. Within the non-null branch it installs lifecycle callbacks and clears accessory4_cb. With no article it performs no writes and leaves accessory4_cb installed.

evidence.why: Exact entry arguments and unconditional scheduling.
Deferred command is guarded by article existence and current motion.

facts.rationale: Separates unconditional fighter-state entry from conditional deferred article synchronization without implying immediate or guaranteed article adoption.
facts.value: Unconditionally requests ftGw_MS_Attack100End with flags 0, floating arguments 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f and NULL, then schedules ftGw_Attack11_DecideAction. The deferred callback sends the Greenhouse end command only if an article exists and the current motion_id is still Attack100End. A non-null article permits lifecycle callback installation and accessory4_cb clearing; a null article leaves the scheduled callback unchanged.
